item.title: Rallying Cry – November 24, 2026
item.description: Pakistan’s Zeeshan Ali is set to launch into space with China’s Shenzhou-24 mission, while Morocco’s upside-down sculpture park dazzles visitors and Thailand takes steps to protect rivers by banning harmful mining exports.
